name: default-swapy
blurb: Draggable bento grid with swappable stat and feature cards.
description: A 12-column grid layout with drag-to-rearrange cards. Cards snap into grid positions; swap detection logs reordered items.
use_when: Dashboards or personalized layouts where users want to rearrange stat cards and widgets on the fly.
avoid_when: Layouts where card reordering shouldn't be enabled or where touch interactions need predictable positioning.
a11y: Draggable items via Swapy library; keyboard and pointer support depend on library implementation.
